findings.text: ask_path re-implements the readable-slug-plus-8-hex-digest naming of reckon/crew/decision_answers.py:49 _claim_name (lines 57-59) instead of extending or wrapping that owner, so two copies of the same naming rule must be kept in step and the promotion clone detector will see the copy.

The section done_when names docs/evidence/fragments/lead-decisions-reach-one-place/s4.html as the rehearsal record and no s4.html exists at the reviewed head, so a reader following the plan's link finds no record even though the content landed under the node slug as this fragment.

No added assertion reads a choice's question or context, and measure/rehearsal-final.json's presented rows carry neither field, so a regression dropping context from lead_presentation.py:98 choice() would leave the whole gate green while the done_when's 'each presented with ... context' fails.

`assert result.exit_code in (0, 1)` is satisfied by a presentation that errors, and the payload check is skipped on exit 1, so the verb's output is untested on exactly the path where a regression would show.

The two-presenter test calls present() sequentially, while decision_answers.claim_presentation is a read-then-write with no lock, so a regression that lets two simultaneous presents both claim one decision would leave this test green.
